rationale: The project has 8 feeds in the backlog but all workers share a single upstream account, creating a rate-limit risk. No load test or account-limit change has been recorded, so there is no evidence that 4 or 8 concurrent workers would be sustainable against that shared account. Setting worker_count to 2 doubles throughput (reducing the backlog twice as fast as the current value of 1) while remaining within a conservatively safe concurrency level for a single shared account. This is the highest choice that evidence supports as sustainable.
